Carried forward from anchor-v7-beta-2026-08-23c.json, WITH ONE MATERIAL UPDATE. Original scope unchanged: device-local storage; Sentry PII scrubbing verified by operations.test; AU-appropriate monitoring; no real identity transmitted; /api/acceptance/sentry is pinned to preview builds only and gated by bearer token plus sentinel format check. THE OPEN ITEM RECORDED IN THE BETA RECORD IS UPDATED HERE: that record found, via acceptance runs #20 and #21 on 2026-08-23, that Sentry's ingestion attaches user.ip_address and a derived user.geo to every event regardless of application-side scrubbing, and stated the only effective control was the Sentry project setting Security & Privacy > 'Prevent Storing of IP Addresses'. That setting was checked directly in the Sentry org settings for mobmind-collective-foundation on 2026-09-02 (scrubIPAddresses checkbox, confirmed checked: true via the settings UI). RESIDUAL GAP, STATED HONESTLY: the toggle change has not yet been re-verified end to end - no fresh acceptance run has delivered a synthetic event and read it back through Sentry's API since the setting was changed, so it is not yet confirmed that ip_address/geo actually come back null under the new setting the way runs #20/#21 showed them populated under the old one. Re-running the acceptance check (POST /api/acceptance/sentry, read back via Sentry's API) before or immediately after this release goes live is recommended so this closes on verified evidence rather than on the settings toggle alone. THIS APPROVAL DOES NOT ITSELF CLOSE THAT GAP - it records what has and has not been verified so the release owner can decide whether to require the re-run before production, or accept the toggle as sufficient and verify after.

known_issues: UPDATED FROM BETA RECORD, NOT YET FULLY CLOSED: Sentry storing client IP address and derived geolocation for every event. The Sentry project setting Security & Privacy > 'Prevent Storing of IP Addresses' - identified in the beta record as the only effective control - was verified switched on in Sentry org settings for mobmind-collective-foundation on 2026-09-02. NOT YET DONE: an acceptance run delivering a fresh synthetic event and confirming ip_address/geo now come back null, the way runs #20/#21 confirmed they came back populated under the old setting. Unlike beta, production is intended to be used by real people, so the impact of leaving this unverified is not nil the way it was for an unlinked, noindex beta. Recommend closing this with a fresh acceptance run before or immediately after go-live.

decision.notes: APPROVED by the release owner (Lauren) 2026-09-03. This promotes the exact artifact already approved and proven live in beta (commit 4ec9749, record anchor-v7-beta-2026-08-23c.json) to production, unchanged. No component, route, style, taxonomy, support-library, meal-library or ecosystem-contract file differs from what beta has been running since 2026-08-23. The six governance approvals are carried forward on that basis, not re-sought, consistent with how the beta record itself carried approvals forward across repins. ONE ITEM WAS FLAGGED, NOT SILENTLY CLOSED, AND THE RELEASE OWNER HAS REVIEWED AND ACCEPTED IT: the beta record's open privacy risk (Sentry storing IP/geo) had its control switched on 2026-09-02, but had not been re-verified end to end with a fresh acceptance run at the time of this approval - see governance.approvals.privacy and risk.known_issues. The release owner has approved proceeding with a re-verification acceptance run to follow promptly after go-live rather than gating the release on it.
